Launch the ERun desktop app

Usage:
  erun app [flags]
  erun app [command]

Available Commands:
  restart     Restart the running desktop app in place to pick up a rebuild

Flags:
      --dry-run    Resolve and trace mutating actions without executing them.
      --headless   Run the desktop backend without a Wails window and serve the frontend over HTTP
  -h, --help       help for app
      --port int   HTTP listen port for --headless mode (defaults to the desktop binary's default)

Global Flags:
      --output string   Result format: text (default, human stream) or json (structured result on stdout for orchestrators). (default "text")
      --time            Print the elapsed runtime after the command finishes.
  -v, --verbose count   Increase verbosity: -v streams external tool output, -vv adds erun command traces.

Use "erun app [command] --help" for more information about a command.
